name: Field & Form

scenarios: All 16 current Overworld rigs plus two legacy appearances, eight village outfits, actual bounded head tracking across repeated body/camera rotations and saved villager reload
All 97 flat item shapes, representative actual textures in hand, F5, real Q drop, camera-facing sprites and retained solid block/weapon geometry
Actual terrain worker directional UVs, local pack-change remeshing, fitted chest/workstation/door/torch/plant/rail rendering, 48-pixel bamboo stalk mask
Exact standalone with outside requests blocked: 330 block-face pixel comparisons, all 97 imported icons, real cutout rendering, drop and Creative inventory
Reversible four-pack switching, unchanged edits, saved preference and block/inventory reload across a chunk boundary
Normal Vite entry with saved pack, world creation and actual W movement

modelBatches.scope: Visible rigid model meshes before optional shadows or combat-warning meshes; not measured hardware FPS.

visualReview.correction: Screenshot review caught the native opaque bamboo UV texture filling crossed panels. Its three-pixel shaft is now centered on transparency; source provenance, unit checks, real atlas checks and all six browser scenarios were rerun after correction.

fixtureNotes: An early creature fixture lacked production createEntity turn/dir fields and was corrected; source simulation was unchanged. Original block-preservation tests now explicitly cover the intentional flat door item while retaining old solid-block/pistol fingerprints.
limits: Animated strips use frame zero with existing shimmer; full resource-pack metadata/models are not implemented.
Custom and bed artwork retain original fallback; workstation fronts retain the fixed north-facing orientation.
Original AI/steering, collision, combat and progression limitations remain; models do not change hitboxes.
Native Windows launch is unverified on this Linux host; the exact embedded payload is byte-for-byte verified.
Managed Chromium blocks direct file://; identical standalone is tested over HTTP with outside requests blocked.
The complete historical Survival progression and multiplayer browser suite were not repeated; this is not a zero-bug guarantee.
